meta.note: v4 evolves v3: v3 values kept where they pass; new roles/primitives added. Hosted Google fonts (no files).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Light = cream (marketing, auth, legal pages); dark = app shell.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, sidebar (dark).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, hovered rows, assistant messages. Light relies on shadow-md.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
